calls.thesis: Comfort Systems USA: signal 'buy a lot' dialled back by his system to 'buy a little' (priced near top of own range, PEG ~1.3). Sales +50% and EPS nearly doubled last quarter, backlog ~$14B (+73% YoY), profits expected +23% next year. Condition: wait for earnings in a few days, then build a case. First tracked BWB call on FIX.
calls.base_case: Forecasts raised ~11% since July (7 raises, 0 cuts in last month) while stock -16% since July.
calls.bull_case: Tech/data-centre customers now ~60% of sales vs 43% a year ago; beat estimates 4 quarters in a row.
calls.bear_case: Backlog depends on big-tech build pace; most jobs fixed-price, so labour/material overruns hit profit directly.
